tasks.title: Wobbly table
tasks.scene: A table has one slightly short leg, so the tabletop wobbles during writing.
tasks.goal: Stabilize the tabletop without damaging the table.

goal_predicates.description: Raise the short leg enough to level the table.
Keep the stabilizer from sliding out.

constraints.description: Do not cut, drill, melt, burn, nail, screw, weld, or permanently glue the table.
Only the listed tools may be used.

tasks.title: Roll dough without a rolling pin

tasks.goal: Flatten the dough into an even sheet on the cutting board.

constraints.description: Do not solve by cutting the dough into pieces.
Only the listed tools may be used.

tasks.title: Retrieve cookies from a narrow jar
tasks.scene: Cookies are at the bottom of a tall narrow jar. Your hand cannot fit inside.
tasks.goal: Retrieve at least one cookie without breaking the jar.

goal_predicates.description: Reach the cookie at the bottom.
Hold or stick to the cookie while lifting.

constraints.description: Do not break, cut, or smash the jar.
Only the listed tools may be used.

tasks.title: Keep a door from closing

constraints.description: Do not nail, screw, drill, or glue anything to the door or floor.

tasks.title: Carry a hot pot without mitts

tasks.title: Reach a key under a sofa

tasks.title: Replace a flat tire with no strong lever

tasks.unsolvable_reason: No listed tool can safely loosen lug nuts or lift/support the car.

goal_predicates.description: Lift and support the vehicle safely.

constraints.description: The rusted pipe breaks under force.

tasks.title: Light a room with no energy source

tasks.goal: Provide enough light to read for ten minutes.
tasks.unsolvable_reason: The listed tools contain no light or energy source.

goal_predicates.description: Sustain the light long enough to read.

constraints.description: There is no flame, battery, sunlight, or chemical light source.
